text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — courier dropped a large suitcase + medium potted plant at the front desk for our 1:00pm visitor (Dr. Chen). Front desk says lobby is getting crowded. Can somebody claim or confirm storage? Also need a visitor badge ready (affiliation: Harbor Research).

Liam (Front Desk): Logged as items PKG-443 (suitcase) and FRG-21 (plant). Temporarily in locker B2. Also FYI Dr. Chen isn't on the public calendar under that name — anyone schedule?

Jordan: I invited them — event shows "Research partner — Chen (Harbor)" at 13:00. I'll swing by 12:50 to grab the suitcase and help with carry.

Priya (People Ops): I can pre-print a one-time visitor badge. @Liam can you scan their ID and have them sign the visitor form? Also we'll issue guest wifi for two hours.

Liam (Front Desk): Yep. Need ID scan + signed form. I'll hold both items in B2 until collection. Small ask — we only have one empty hotdesk near demo room. Jordan, can you move to bench 2 for the hour?

Jordan: Bench 2 works for me. I'll leave my stuff in a box and put a sticky note on 3B. :thumbsup:

Ben (Facilities): If suitcase looks heavy I can help carry it to storage. Also suggest we move the plant to the sunlit supply room so it doesn't drip water in the lobby.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Ben — please avoid the open-floor plan watering. Also Dr. Chen requested vegetarian snacks if we have any — small thing but helpful.

CourierBot: Package PKG-443 scanned by courier. Photo: courier_photo_1832455967.jpg (on drop). Estimated pickup by recipient: 2024-09-12 13:15.

Priya (People Ops): Noted on snacks and vegetarian. Liam — once they check in can you pass the badge and wifi info? I'll email the host confirmation.

Liam (Front Desk): Checked in: Dr. Chen arrived and signed at 13:03. Badge printed and handed over. Suitcase and plant moved to locker B2 and Sunlit Room respectively. Jordan confirmed desk swap. All set. :white_check_mark:

Maya (People Ops): Amazing — thanks everyone for the quick shuffle.

Jordan: No prob — glad we avoided lobby pile-up. :grin:
